entries.summary: ### parcel_key_normalizer.py `normalize_apn` (line 17) uppercases and replaces punctuation with spaces. Its return expression at lines 35–36 removes zeros from every numeric segment, although its docstring says only the first segment. `parcel_key` (line 39) accepts unvalidated integer FIPS values;

entries.title: equity_estimator.py
entries.summary: ### equity_estimator.py `amortized_balance` (line 23) applies a default 6%/30-year mortgage. `estimated_equity` (line 38) amortizes the debt from the property sale date, even when a loan originated later. Missing debt becomes zero. Missing sale-side HPI becomes flat price carry;

entries.title: census_acs_enrich.py
entries.summary: ### census_acs_enrich.py `geocode` (line 23) uses `Current_Current10`, which is not an available current vintage, takes the first address/tract without checking ambiguity, and does not retain match evidence.

entries.title: Implementation and validation
entries.summary: ## Implementation and validation New implementation is in `server/public-records/`, with the bounded command `scripts/collect-public-records.js`. It returns evidence without changing the listing database, parcel-boundary route, underwriting values, or saved listing truth.
